_comment: The one eldenring.exe this port accepts, read by mod.ps1 doctor, control/build-package.ps1 and the native client build (the bridge's build gate). An in-game candidate, not a qualified build. Change it only from a fresh read of the installed file (docs/engine-packs/elden-ring.md, Engine and version); any other file leaves the bridge off and refuses the package build.
